values.task_boundary: Deliver working evaluation bindings, durable adaptation deltas, governed graph mutation, and replay-safe Adaptive Learning DAG execution.
deliverables: working evaluation bindings, durable adaptation deltas, governed graph mutation, and replay-safe Adaptive Learning DAG execution
real adaptive execution, deterministic replay, durable state deltas, accepted and rejected mutation paths, and required negative cases
acceptance_criteria: The Adaptive Learning DAG executes real Runtime v3 behavior at the exact reviewed revision
Declared dependencies are verified from current evidence
Every accepted state or graph change is policy-authorized, durable, and deterministically replayable
Rejected mutation, forged history, discontinuous resume, invalid binding, unbounded recurrence, and missing evidence are proven negative cases
No fixture, receipt, demo mode, synthetic result, or planning document substitutes for runtime behavior
One bounded pre-PR review has no unresolved actionable findings
non_goals: Treating a planning packet as implementation
